articles.title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday Fixes 1,093 Vulnerabilities, Including Outlook Zero-Day
articles.summary:
Microsoft has released its November 2026 Patch Tuesday updates, fixing 1,093 newly released vulnerabilities across Windows, Office, SQL Server, SharePoint, Exchange Server, Azure services, and developer tools. The release includes one actively exploited zero-day in Microsoft Outlook that can leak a user’s NTLMv2 authentication hash to an attacker. This update addresses 63 critical vulnerabilities, 1,029 […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Notion Confirms AI Chat Transcripts Exposed in Fireworks AI Breach, Affecting Customer Workspaces
articles.summary:

Insights, a feature that helps teams understand their AI usage, used the affected conversations. Notion said its own systems were not breached and no other Notion features were affected. articles.title: Barracuda Confirms Active Exploitation of Email Gateway Flaws Allowing Root Access
articles.summary:
